seeded_failure.symptom: The container shows as running, but requests to the published port fail.
seeded_failure.cause: The application listens on 127.0.0.1 inside the container, so traffic arriving on the container's network interface is refused.
seeded_failure.fix: Bind the application to 0.0.0.0, rebuild the image and confirm with curl and docker logs.
